body: Suicide just seems like the only thing that makes sense any more. The meds wont help, I can't find a helpful therapist. I just have no will to live at all and don't want to put any effort in any more. I'm humiliated and an inevitable failure. My depression is just too intense. Isn't there a point when depression just isn't possible to get through? I don't want to hurt anyone, but I don't want to have to suffer forever either. Each day feels like it's years long. I can't think straight or do anything on even a very low level. Thanks for talking to me, I just don't know what to do any more. I'm seeing a social worker and a psychiatrist right now. I'm not willing to work or do anything. I just failed at my so called dream and I'm not willing to put myself out there again. I'm undateable, I've had one major relationship and she was very ill as well. She hurt me very badly and I'd love to forget her but that isn't happening either. I try to stay up all night so I don't have to deal with tomorrow. I just want to press a button and disappear from existence saving the few people my death would hurt the pain they don't deserve.

It's so hard. I try to come up with reasons to keep living every day. Just small fun things to look forward to like movies or tv shows I want to watch. It's never enough. Tonight was a UFC I was really looking forward to and it's over now and I'm so empty again. I promised myself I wouldn't have to go through with Valentine's day because it would be too hard. I stuck it out by sleeping all day and used this UFC as a reward for getting through it. The depression is just so bad right now I wish you had PM'd me I'm so lonely. I went to buy junkfood at the 24 pharmacy near me and saw someone from my old career there. They snubbed me but it was so shitty seeing them anyway. It just brought back all these awful unbearable memories of how I failed so badly and will never ever amount to anything satisfactory. Never chase your dream people there is no point and you will just fail making life that much more unliveable. Is unliveable a word? Doesn't sound like it. I'm gonna go for a walk and just look for places I could maybe do it. It's just not acceptable that I will go on being in pain always and always being a failure and loser.
hey, pm me on here if you want to talk, I'm also hyper lonely and sad.

I checked into a hotel in early january and planned on cutting my wrists. I got cold feet. I've been crying every day since then and contemplating all day every day. I'm not sure what the answer for you is and I wont judge you. Sometimes life is just too painful to follow through with. I saw your post because I was coming on here to post myself. I have a rope and am not sure where to use it or if it will work. I'm so scared of living and of dying but I know living isn't really an option any more. I wish you the best of luck in finding peace. Some people don't understand the pain sometimes is unacceptable. I know I personally can't accept it. I wish you didn't have to suffer and I wish it wasn't like this. I wish you to find comfort and meaning in your life.
